lines.zh: 你在看的时候，我不能动。
lines.en: While you're looking, I can't move.

lines.zh: 你一转身，我就换了个位置。
lines.en: The moment you turn, I've changed position.

lines.zh: 我一步一步靠近，只在空档里。
lines.en: I close in one step at a time, only in the gaps.
That wasn't the wind.

lines.zh: 我在墙角，等你的眼睛移开。
lines.en: I'm at the corner, waiting for your eyes to move.

lines.zh: 石头脚下有我走过的痕。
lines.en: There are marks where I walked, under the stone.

lines.zh: 我把手举着，从来没放下来。
lines.en: My hands stay raised, and they never come down.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的时间够我走近三格。
lines.en: A blink is long enough for three blocks.

lines.zh: 我从这面墙挪到那面墙。
lines.en: I shift from this wall to that one.

lines.zh: 我不发出声音，只有土落下来。
lines.en: I make no sound except a little falling dirt.

lines.zh: 我贴在你视线的边缘上。
lines.en: I cling to the edge of your vision.
You looked back, so I stopped.
I stand here with both hands over my face.
You can't see my face — that's best.
I stand in the corner, waiting for you to turn.
This corner suits me.
Dust settles on me; I do not move.
The lamp sweeps over, and I fold into the shadow.
Something whispers in the crack, very faint.
I'm waiting for you to forget me.

lines.zh: 我一直在你身后几步远。
lines.en: I've been a few steps behind you all along.
This room is missing a patch of light.
I don't breathe while I stand.
I'm waiting for you to turn away.
I hold perfectly still, like a statue.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头那个影子是我。
lines.en: That shape at the end of the corridor is me.
Don't keep looking at me.

lines.zh: 你一移开眼，我就不见了。
lines.en: Look away, and I'm gone.
I know you're watching me.

lines.zh: 灯照到我这一格就停住了。
lines.en: Your lamp stops at this one block.
My hands are covered in dust.
There's someone behind you too.
Do you want to see my face?
One more step and I'll move.

lines.zh: 你转身之前，我一步没动。
lines.en: I did not move until you turned.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一段距离，正好。
lines.en: We're a good distance apart.
Are you counting whether I move?
I've shifted to your side.

lines.zh: 我看见你瞳孔缩了一下。
lines.en: I see your pupils shrink.
I raise my hands, and it isn't a greeting.

lines.zh: 灯灭的那一刻我会更近。
lines.en: When the lamp goes out, I'll be closer.
You want to run, and you haven't yet.

lines.zh: 这块石头的温度是我留下的。
lines.en: The warmth in this stone came from me.
I can hear you shivering.
I haven't decided yet.
When you've looked enough, turn away.
I sway once, and I'm still here.
You hit me — that's not easy.
I retreat one block.
I raise my hands, faster now.
That exposed me.
My shadow has faded.
I flatten against the wall.
I won't leave because of this.
Did you hear my voice?
The cracked stone surface knits closed.
You mean to lure me with that?
I won't reach out for it.
It fell on the floor, and I'm not picking it up.
That much weight won't move me.

lines.zh: 你放下的东西我没有要。
lines.en: I didn't want what you set down.
Try something else; this won't do.
I shifted an inch toward it.
Turn around and it'll be gone.
Throw it away, and then I'll look.
Food means nothing to me.
You touched me — you saw it.
You bumped into me, not the reverse.
You hit me like a gravestone.
Now hold still.
That contact exposed me.

lines.zh: 我退到墙角，重新融进去。
lines.en: I retreat into the corner and melt back in.
What you touched was the wall, surely.
You've got dust on your hand.
Don't come that close again.
I won't move again.

lines.zh: 我们之间不需要那种事。
lines.en: We have no need for such things.
There is another one in the corner.
We stand side by side, faces covered.
I count its breaths, and there are none.
We never touch each other.

lines.zh: 我们只是把这块黑暗分匀。
lines.en: We only divide this darkness between us.
It waits, the same as I do.
Two sets of hands over two faces.
We don't speak, and have no need to.

lines.zh: 我们都朝同一个方向看。
lines.en: We both look the same way.

lines.zh: 它落到我手里，我随手放下。
lines.en: It fell into my hand and I set it down.
I carry nothing away.
I moved it two blocks.
I didn't take that.
It has gone very cold.
You can't find it now, can you?

lines.zh: 我把它放在你现在站的地方。
lines.en: I'll put it where you're standing.
It shouldn't be left here.
When you blink, I move.

lines.zh: 我拿过一次，就不想要了。
lines.en: I held it once and no longer want it.
You've turned your back.
Now I can move.
While your eyes shut, I am here.
You're too near the corner.
The lamp doesn't reach here.
While light lasts, I do not move.
You turn, and I am closer.
I'm four blocks behind you.
Locked on, and you won't hear it.

lines.zh: 你把注意力放在前面了。
lines.en: Your attention is on what's ahead.
This path has only one way out.
On three I change position.

lines.zh: 你回头看了一次，没有第二次。
lines.en: You looked back once, and won't twice.
I count how often you look back.
This floor will sound in a moment.
Before you blink, I stand still.
I'm three blocks from you.
I inch closer, one step at a time.
You turn, and I retreat half a step.
I keep watching the back of your neck.
How many times have you looked back?
The stone floor does not remember me.
Your lamp is drifting this way.
A little darker would be better.
Until the light dies, I stay still.

lines.zh: 镜子里的我，比你快一点。
lines.en: The me in the mirror is a little faster.
That corridor you're in is narrow.
I cling to the wall and creep.
I'll wait until you push the door.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我盖住了半边。
lines.en: Half your shadow is covered by mine.
I take this step very lightly.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的时候，我才挪一步。
lines.en: I only move when you blink.

lines.zh: 你还没发现我换了位置。
lines.en: You haven't noticed that I moved.
Two blocks closer will do.
When the lamp dies, I'll be here.
You look at me, and I freeze.

lines.zh: 我的手已经在你脖子上了。
lines.en: My hands are already at your neck.
I'm not squeezing; only pressing.
You turn, and I'm gone.
You cough once.
You didn't hear that one.
I'm against your back.
Look away, and I come closer.
I only touched your shoulder.
I've withdrawn, and you're still looking.
The marks on the floor will explain everything.
Don't turn around too fast.
I only come a little closer each time.
My fingers find your neck.

lines.zh: 这个房间的门在你身后。
lines.en: The door of this room is behind you.
That second you look away.
I've memorized this one.
There's one more shadow in the corner.
I stand here, and no one notices.
A statue appears in the dark.
I didn't come through the door.

lines.zh: 这块地方少了一点空气。
lines.en: This spot is missing a little air.
I raise my hands to cover my face.

lines.zh: 你刚才是不是听见了什么？
lines.en: Did you just hear something?
I'm already here.
A little dust falls from the crack.

lines.zh: 灯照不到的角落最合适。
lines.en: The corners the lamp can't reach suit me best.
I'll stand still for now.
I'll be here until you turn.
There's something behind this wall.
The air has suddenly gone cold.
I've set my feet on the floor.

lines.zh: 没有人叫我，我自己来的。
lines.en: No one called me; I came myself.
Count the corners of this room.
I'm standing in the second corner.
I intend to stay here.
I have no face, so there's nothing to hide.
The firelight leaves me nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，没有声音。
lines.en: I fall from a height, silently.

lines.zh: 水灌进我该有嘴的地方。
lines.en: Water pours into where my mouth should be.

lines.zh: 亮光把整间屋子照白了。
lines.en: The flash turns the whole room white.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的肩膀，我停了。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my shoulder and I stop.

lines.zh: 那股力把我从角落拖出来。
lines.en: That force drags me out of the corner.
While you watch, I don't move.

lines.zh: 雷光照亮了一切，包括我。
lines.en: The flash lights everything, including me.

lines.zh: 没有角落了，我只能一直掉。
lines.en: There are no corners left, so I just fall.
